name: Mail relay
description: Email for every app on this server through one SMTP login: Amazon SES, SendGrid, Fastmail or any other provider. Each bound app gets SMTP_URL with its own token, never the account's login; mail goes out only from your domains, with a limit per app.

env.desc: Your provider's SMTP server. Amazon SES: email-smtp.REGION.amazonaws.com (like email-smtp.us-west-2.amazonaws.com). SendGrid: smtp.sendgrid.net. Port 587 unless you add one.
Amazon SES: the SMTP username from SES > SMTP settings (not an access key). SendGrid: the word apikey.
Amazon SES: the SMTP password from the same page. SendGrid: an API key with Mail Send.
Domains apps may send from, like example.com (subdomains too)
Recipients one app may send to an hour

email.desc: sends through your SMTP login (Amazon SES, SendGrid or any provider)
